description: Unit tests for the iMessage sent-message echo cache, testing caching behavior based on message content, message IDs, and timing.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite for the iMessage sent-message echo cache.

methods.name: afterEach
methods.description: Cleanup function called after each test to restore real timers.

methods.description: Defines individual test cases for cache behavior.
